coach.action: Engage at Round 5 — pick Sunfire Aegis on anvil.
coach.fight_rule: All-in when your W is active. Silence the carry first.
coach.round_strategy: Prioritize survivability — 2 teams left with fed Jinx.
coach.augment_advice: Take Celestial Body — you need the HP more than damage.
coach.anvil_advice: Sunfire Aegis over Warmog. Warmog is only good vs poke.
coach.risk: Thresh hook sets up their burst combo. Bait it before engaging.
coach.immediate: Hold W for their CC chain. Pop it after Thresh hook.
coach.pregame: Garen vs Jinx — you survive; they delete.
